newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains drift in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains drift in slow trade.

text.p: UK physical grain trading was in the doldrums on Monday with traders hoping for a pick up in business.

"We've got to kid ourselves that there will be some business between now and the New Year. But realistically we can't see much happeing now, unless there is a major upset in the currency markets," said a trader.
On the fob market buyer and sellers were in a 0.50-stg standoff with Jan/Mar feed wheat bid at 100.50 stg and offered at 101 stg. Apr/Jun was bid at 102.50 with sellers at 103 stg.
Spot feed barley was offered at 100 stg and bid at 99 stg.
Delivered traded levels were unchanged from Friday in thin trade with milling wheat 11 percent protein in the London area fetching 116 stg while 118.50 stg was paid for Jan/Mar in Yorkshire.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 99 stg for January and 103 stg for April/June.
Barley in the Avon range fetched 99 stg for Jan and 100 stg for Jan/Mar.
